run_detectFaces_main: run detectFaces.py to track faces in a video and output per-speaker face crops, landmarks, and tracked videos
build_face2head: build square head bounding boxes from face detection boxes by scaling width and height with a given scalar factor
test_bb_intersection_over_union: test the bb_intersection_over_union function to compute IoU between two bounding boxes for speaker tracking association
refactor_face2head: refactor face2head to accept arbitrary aspect ratios instead of forcing square bounding boxes around face centers
review_main: review the main function that reads a video, detects faces with MTCNN, tracks speakers via IoU, and saves landmarks and face videos
